description: This file defines the PluginConfigurationInterface interface within the OrangeHRM framework. It declares a single method initialize that takes a Request object as a parameter, intended for plugin initialization routines.

classes.name: PluginConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface within the OrangeHRM framework requiring implementing classes to define an initialize method that accepts a Request object, used for plugin setup.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to initialize a plugin with a given HTTP request.
